comment: trap.c trapeffect_pit() 1899: a debug Valkyrie wishes a pit under herself, polymorphs (#polyself) into a pit viper, steps off and back onto the unseen pit and falls in: 'How pitiful.  Isn't that the pits?'. Not covered: 1847 (riding a named steed into a pit), 1855-1856 (a clinger over a known pit: dotrap() lets a wumpus escape the known pit first, also via #sit), and 1882-1885 (entering an adjacent pit while still trapped, which domove() never allows: it passes trapmove() a null desttrap, hack.c 2831).
